rationale: Internally consistent and the highest-prior untested cell of the archive's moderator × yield grid, but it is pure recombination of two existing signals with no new economic content, so it is informative only as a confirmatory test rather than a genuine extension.

The expression genuinely computes what the hypothesis claims (mean ROA applied to current assets, priced against equity), it is a well-posed diagnostic for whether the winner was a stale-growth tilt, and the reviewer should note it collapses algebraically to average-profitability × assets-to-price — a decomposition close to the published profitability-scaled-value family — so the result must be interpreted against that benchmark rather than as fresh.

A clean single-factor change (denominator claim on capital) with the moderator and profit measure held fixed, but it is another grid cell in an already dense family, likely highly correlated with both parents, and the denominator omits cash so it is not a true EV yield.

This is the most genuinely new construct in the batch — a price-scaled cyclical-depression gap rather than another multiple — but the expected positive sign is a direct bet against the well-documented profitability premium (the signal is mechanically highest for firms with collapsing current earnings), so it must be read as a test of that tension and not a refinement of the normalized-yield winner.

The substitution of a within-industry margin count for the absolute 10% hurdle addresses a real confound (sector membership masquerading as franchise durability) with the valuation leg held constant, making this the most substantively motivated refinement here, though INDICATOR at a zero threshold on a demeaned variable will split roughly 50/50 each year and may therefore be a noisier gate than intended.

Peak-versus-mean is a legitimate alternative normalization anchor and the durability gate is the right guard against one-off windfalls, but TS_MAX will be very highly correlated with the five-year mean for the durable subsample the gate selects, so the marginal information over Signal 1 is likely small and the result should be judged on incremental, not standalone, evidence.
